name: svgdiagram
description: Create editable SVG diagrams from structured content and use free diagram makers.

interface.longDescription: Create diagrams for planning, teaching and presenting inside ChatGPT. Choose from 24 starter layouts or open 10 manual makers. Customize titles, fonts, styles and colors, then export vector SVG or presentation-ready PNG. ChatGPT supplies structured content to SVG Diagram’s rendering engine. No separate SVG Diagram account is required. The app processes supplied diagram content and cannot access your SVG Diagram account, private files or existing diagram history. Temporary download links expire within one hour and may expire earlier after cache eviction or service restarts.
defaultPrompt: Create a SWOT diagram for my design studio.
Show me the free diagram makers.
Help me turn these steps into a process diagram.

positive.prompt: Which diagram layouts can I create?
positive.expected_behavior: List supported starter layouts with their exact identifiers and useful descriptions.

positive.prompt: Create a SWOT diagram for a design studio. Strengths: visual identity, fast delivery. Weaknesses: limited capacity, uneven leads. Opportunities: partnerships, education. Threats: price competition, client concentration. Title: Studio strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a supported SWOT schema and display an inline vector diagram containing the supplied points and title.

positive.prompt: Open the free diagram makers so I can edit a diagram myself.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the branded maker workspace with ten types, examples, editable fields and SVG/PNG export.

positive.prompt: Change the SWOT diagram to Archivo, use a mono style, and set its title to Studio growth strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the prior content, change the specified appearance and title, and provide the updated preview.

positive.prompt: Find supported chart icons I could use in a diagram.
positive.expected_behavior: Return exact identifiers from the supported icon catalog. Do not invent identifiers.

negative.prompt: Fetch the private diagrams saved in my SVG Diagram account.
Delete my diagrams from Figma and replace them with this one.
Buy a paid SVG Diagram subscription with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin renders free diagrams and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with 24 starter layouts, ten manual makers, appearance editing, and SVG/PNG export.
